name: TaxCycle
summary: Professional tax preparation and CRA e-filing for Canadian accountants and bookkeepers, sold per module and per user, with bundles for the full suite. Canada-only, and not a consumer filing app.
best_for: Canadian accountants and bookkeepers who prepare and e-file client returns and want fast, checked, CRA-integrated professional tax software
skip_if: you're an individual filing your own personal return (consumer software is far cheaper), or you're outside Canada
honest_knock: This is professional preparer software priced for firms, not a consumer filing app: the cost only makes sense if you're preparing returns for clients at volume. The suites start at about CAD $1,655 a year for one user and each extra seat adds several hundred dollars, so a two- or three-person practice should budget the suite price plus seats, plus GST or HST, before comparing it with per-return alternatives.

pricing.notes: Prices are published on www.taxcycle.com/pricing (Canadian dollars before tax, per year, single user). Read 27 September 2026, after the September sale ended on the 24th: Tax Basics 2026 $1,655 (reg. $1,680) with additional users at $540; the Complete Tax Suite $2,700 (reg. $2,800) with extra users at $756; the Complete Tax Suite plus TaxFolder $2,852 (reg. $3,102) with extra users at $944. Those are still discounts, of $25, $100 and $250, under a banner that read 'Sale Ends Dec 18' on 27 September and reads 'Only Until Dec 17' on 13 October, with a 12-month payment plan offered only during the sale. On 9 September, in the deeper September sale, the same three were $1,600, $2,625 and $2,752. The page also states that all software is licensed per calendar year, not as an ongoing subscription; on 13 October it adds that software purchased that day is licensed through 31 December 2027. Every module is also priced separately: TaxCycle T1 $618 (+$238/user), T2 $1,102 (+$248), T3 $532 (+$211), T5013 $516 (+$211), T2202 $558 (+$211), T3010 $268 (+$86), Forms $270 (+$27), and the slip modules T4/T4A, T5, T5018, NR4 and RL $268 each (+$27). TaxFolder is $375 (+$215) and licensed to the end of 2027; DoxCycle $280 (+$167); Data Mining a $242 site licence; Québec TP1 a $198 site licence. Three-user and ten-user tiers are listed on their own tabs. The module prices were unchanged on 27 September 2026, and every package and module price was unchanged again on 13 October 2026.
